title: Mark Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Mark 1: John baptizing in the wilderness, the baptism of Jesus, the first disciples, the synagogue in Capernaum and the leper who was made clean.

questions.text: What did John preach in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.

answers.text: The rebuilding of the temple in Jerusalem
The law of Moses to the priests
The baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins
A fast of forty days for all Judea

questions.explanation: John was clothed with camel's hair and a leather belt, and he ate locusts and wild honey.

answers.text: Locusts and wild honey
Bread and wine
Fish and barley loaves
Figs and almonds

questions.text: In what did John say the mightier one would baptize?
questions.explanation: John said, "I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit."

answers.text: In the Jordan river
In the Holy Spirit
In water and oil
In the words of the prophets

questions.text: What did the voice out of the sky say at the baptism of Jesus?
questions.explanation: A voice came out of the sky saying, "You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased."

answers.text: "This man is the prophet of Israel."
"Listen to the voice in the wilderness."
"The time is fulfilled, repent!"
"You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased."

questions.text: What did Jesus say he would make Simon and Andrew into?
questions.explanation: Jesus said to Simon and Andrew, "Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men."

answers.text: Shepherds of Israel
Teachers of the law
Fishers for men
Servants of the temple

questions.text: Why were the people in the synagogue astonished at his teaching?
questions.explanation: They were astonished because he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

answers.text: He taught as having authority, not as the scribes
He read from a scroll no one knew
He taught in the language of the prophets
He taught them all night long

questions.text: What happened to the man with the unclean spirit after Jesus rebuked it?
questions.explanation: Jesus said, "Be quiet, and come out of him!" and the unclean spirit convulsed the man, cried with a loud voice and came out of him.

answers.text: The spirit refused and stayed in him
The man fell asleep on the floor
The man ran out of the synagogue
The spirit convulsed him and came out of him

questions.text: What did Jesus do for Simon's wife's mother, who lay sick with a fever?
questions.explanation: He came and took her by the hand and raised her up; the fever left her immediately, and she served them.

answers.text: He sent her to the priest
He took her by the hand and raised her up
He anointed her head with oil
He told her to wash in the sea

questions.text: What did Jesus do early in the morning, while it was still dark?
questions.explanation: He rose up, went out into a deserted place and prayed there.

answers.text: He went to a deserted place and prayed
He taught in the synagogue again
He went back to the house of Simon
He crossed the sea by boat

questions.text: What did Jesus answer the leper who said, "If you want to, you can make me clean"?
questions.explanation: Being moved with compassion he touched him and said, "I want to. Be made clean." The leprosy departed from him at once.

answers.text: "Your sins are forgiven you."
"Go and wash in the river."
"I want to. Be made clean."
"Rise up and walk."
